messages:
Priya (PM): Hi all — I posted the latest product launch blog draft for copy + routing checks. Please skim: https://notion.so/redwood/product-launch-draft-9f3a

Liam (Creative): Nice structure. Hero is wordy though can we tighten to a single sentence that leads with the outcome?

Marisol (Growth): Routing note: we need two distinct flows — Quickstart (self-serve) and Enterprise (sales). Enterprise should capture ARR band and region as hidden fields.

Ben (Sales Ops): Confirmed. Also want a hidden field for "primary_use_case" so SDRs can prioritize. I'll share the exact HubSpot form IDs in a sec.

Omar (Legal): Flag: the line "5x lower per-token cost vs competitors" is risky. Either add sources or soften to "significantly lower per-token costs observed in our tests". No direct competitor callouts without approval.

Priya (PM): Good catch. I'll soften the claim and add a footnote: "internal cost appendix; subject to finance review".

Liam (Creative): Benchmarks callout  can we include a short method blurb? e.g., "benchmarks executed on p4d.24xlarge instances with continuous batching; see repo for raw runs." Keeps it transparent.

Marisol (Growth): Webinar teaser under CTA please: 2 lines max. Proposed: "May 20, 11:00 PT  live demo + benchmark breakdown. Save a seat."

Ben (Sales Ops): HubSpot embed (example):
```
// embed snippet for blog
const hubspot = {
  formId: "form_quickstart" || "form_ent_demo",
  hiddenFields: {
    utm_source: "product_launch",
    utm_medium: "blog",
    utm_campaign: "may_release",
    arr_band: "${arr_band}",
    primary_use_case: "${use_case}",
    region: "${region}"
  }
};
```

Marisol (Growth): I'll map form_quickstart -> lifecycle stage trial; form_ent_demo -> assign to Sales queue B (enterprise). Will surface SDR playbook in the shared drive.

analytics-bot: Quick QA: figure 3 is missing alt text. Suggest alt: "Latency and throughput across sequence lengths". Also recommend GA event on both CTAs.

Liam (Creative): Added alt text note. Also recommend moving the benchmark callout above the fold so readers see the headline metric immediately.

Omar (Legal): Also flag the "customer quote" section: make sure approvals are documented. If it's a partner quote, we need verbatim permission.

Priya (PM): Noted. I'll confirm quote approvals and swap any unapproved copy with generic paraphrase.

analytics-bot: GA snippet suggestion for forms: 
```
document.addEventListener('submit', e => {
  if (e.target.matches('.launch-form')) {
    gtag('event', 'form_submit', { event_label: e.target.dataset.form });
  }
});
```

Ben (Sales Ops): SLA: enterprise leads should be touched within 1 business day. I'll add assignment rules and create a simple triage doc for SDRs.

publish-bot: Checklist update: awaiting approvals from Legal and Sales Ops. Publish scheduled target: 2024-05-06T09:00:00-07:00 (PT). Webinar tentative: 2024-05-20T11:00:00-07:00 (PT). Signoffs required within 48 hours. :hourglass:

Marisol (Growth): I'll wire up UTM rules and hidden field mapping and share a verification doc once done.

Priya (PM): I'll push an updated draft (shorter hero, softened cost language, elevated benchmark callout, alt text added, HubSpot embed with hidden fields) in ~45m. Thanks team, I'll close thread when it's live.

Liam (Creative): Will proof the compressed hero and webinar teaser.

Omar (Legal): Will review the softened claims and the quote approvals document.

Ben (Sales Ops): Will validate routing and SDR playbook.

publish-bot: Reminder set: final publish checklist runs 24h before scheduled publish.
